name: local-ai-studio
description: Set up Local AI Studio and the needed model group when requested, then use its local ai CLI for media or English-to-Korean translation and verify saved results.

interface.shortDescription: Local AI Studio 설치·모델 준비·로컬 작업 결과 확인
interface.longDescription: For requested Local AI Studio or on-device model tasks on Apple Silicon, discover the existing CLI or set up LocalAIHub and only the required model group. Do not install for generic media requests. Respect user-selected tools and storage, obtain explicit Qwen license acceptance when needed, and verify actual output separately from readiness. No model weights, media, credentials, MCP, apps or hooks are bundled.
defaultPrompt: $local-ai-studio로 필요한 경우 Local AI Studio와 모델을 설치하고 요청한 작업의 결과를 확인해주세요.
